messages:
evan: Heads-up — I pushed a small model variant (papaya-13b-lite) to the onboarding branch. Can someone run a quick smoke sweep for tail-latency and perf regressions before I open the PR?

marina: on it. which configs do you want? full seq or short-avg?

evan: short-avg (256 tokens) + one 1024 long tail. prioritize p99 latency and memory OOM checks. use quantized-4bit profile if available.

cheng: pinging perf-ci-bot to enqueue a job. if it fails, attach the kernel fallback logs.

perf-ci-bot: Job enqueued: perf/onboard/papaya-13b-lite/quick-sweep-1790123456 — link: https://ci.redwood.internal/perf/1790123456

ryan: I started the run against g5.2xlarge-equivalent nodes. 4 concurrent workers, batch size 4. baseline comparison target: hyrax-13b-smoke from last week.

marina: early numbers — short-avg (256): mean 32ms/token, p95 72ms, p99 128ms. long (1024): mean 28ms/token (due to KV reuse), p95 65ms, p99 140ms. memory ~10% better than baseline.

evans: nice. any quality regressions from the eval harness?

ryan: ran evals/cli on small evalset. minor differences in repetition score, but within tolerance. attaching snippet:
```
Eval summary: ppl delta +0.02, repetition@4 +0.5%, rouge-l +/-0.1
Decision: acceptable for canary
```

cheng: noted a spike in kernel fallback on one host — stack shows aten/cuda kernel mismatch at step ~300. I re-ran that host; fallback didn't repeat. marking as flaky.

marina: CI artifacts uploaded: perf graphs, flamegraphs, and kv-cache hit-rate. kv hit-rate ~92% on the long run. flamegraph shows attention kernel hotpath consistent with baseline.

evans: great. let's create a canary rollout: 5% traffic to papaya-13b-lite with a fallback to hyrax-13b. can someone file the rollout ticket?

ryan: filing now -> https://tickets.redwood.internal/ROLL/4829. CC @cheng for the rollback playbook.

cheng: adding rollback steps: automatic fallback on p99>150ms or error rate >0.5% for 5m window. I'll add alerts to the canary dashboard.

marina: thumbs up. I'll update the onboarding doc with the perf numbers and artifact links.

evan: thanks all — will wait for the ticket + canary dashboard before merging. :tada:
